mapper.select: SELECT nur.id, nur.type, nur.content, nur.been_read, nur.create_time, us.nickname AS senderName, us.avatar AS senderAvatar, ur.nickname AS recipientName, ur.avatar AS recipientAvatar FROM b_news_user_record nur LEFT JOIN b_user_main us ON nur.target_uid = us.uuid LEFT JOIN b_user_main ur ON nur.uid = ur.uuid ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}
